title: Automations: a failed run shows as failed with its reason, its log and a notification

steps.title: Three automations made; Nightly build run now, and it fails
cmux: clear; cmux automation create 'Nightly build' --command 'echo building; echo "error: 2 tests failed" >&2; exit 3' --manual >/dev/null && cmux automation create 'Every minute' --command 'echo checked disk' --every 1m >/dev/null && cmux automation create 'Morning brief' --prompt 'Summarize my open pull requests' --weekdays 09:00 >/dev/null; cmux automation run 'Nightly build' --wait; cmux automation history 'Nightly build'
